name: edit-o-matic
description: Whitespace-tolerant edit fallback for Pi — not a replacement for the built-in edit tool, but for local/quantized LLM users who also use gentle-pi. Progressive fallback matching (exact → fuzzy → indentation-stripped → combined → line-by-line) with ambiguit
